g.text: The raw and normalized 25-s hierarchies are shown separately because they answer different similarity questions.

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: E, each unit vector concatenates all 80 unsmoothed 25-s single-trial spike-count traces. F, a centered five-bin smooth and separate within-trial z-score are applied before concatenation, reducing domination by firing-

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: rate scale and between-trial offsets. Both panels preserve the complete original matrices, dendrograms, five-class summaries and regional compositions. Teacher-panel counts were used only as comparison targets, never to
